added.name: ansible-vars
added.description: ansible-vault replacement that supports encrypting individual vault variables.

added.name: Orchestrator
added.description: Desktop app that runs AI coding agents in parallel Git worktrees and feeds failed CI checks and review comments back to them. oss

added.name: mnemo-jvm-warden
added.description: Kubernetes controller and sidecar that resize JVM pod memory on a schedule with in-place resize, releasing heap before shrinking the pod.

added.name: Vessel
added.description: Local-first reverse proxy for LLM traffic (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages). Captures requests and responses byte-for-byte to local SQLite with full-text search, TTFT and token metrics, warnings for truncation, cold loads and fumbled tool calls, and replay across models. No SDK; single binary.

added.name: Vobo
added.description: Open-source human review for AI output. Anchored comments and a hashed evidence chain. Self-hostable.

added.name: YYLO Benchmark
added.description: Isolated evaluation layer for agent runs. Normalizes every case into one attempt contract, runs each candidate in a private fresh-repository workspace, and evaluates retained evidence with ordered deterministic and/or LLM profiles; workspace receipts, repository manifests, and terminals stay hash-linked, and records are immutable. Installs via npm as @yylo/benchmark.

added.name: Replayowl
added.description: Open-source, self-hosted session replay that records DOM changes, masked input and console errors; the server runs as one Cloudflare Worker or one Node process and keeps recordings in your own S3-compatible bucket.

added.name: Kilobat CLI
added.description: GPL-3.0-only macOS command-line network monitoring and diagnostics with JSON output and a local MCP server.

added.name: log10x-mcp
added.description: MCP server that ranks log patterns by volume and cost and plans compact, tier down or offload for the excess over each cap on Splunk, Datadog, Elasticsearch, CloudWatch and ClickHouse. Runs locally; read-only without an API key.

added.name: Check Expiry
added.description: GitHub Action for TLS certificate and domain-registration expiry checks, with workflow summaries and configurable warning thresholds.

added.name: otel-budget-check
added.description: GitHub Action that runs your tests with a local OTLP receiver and fails PRs on telemetry cost/cardinality regressions before merge.

added.name: CrashPilot
added.description: Open-source (MIT) Linux crash forensics agent that explains why a machine went down: OOM kills, kernel panics, NVIDIA Xid GPU faults, thermal shutdowns, PCIe and disk errors. crashpilot classify works offline on pasted logs, and a Kubernetes DaemonSet is included.

added.name: RKE2 observability pack
added.description: Grafana dashboards and Prometheus alerts for RKE2 clusters: control plane, embedded etcd and its snapshots, certificates, networking, ingress, and cost per namespace with or without OpenCost.

added.name: SLO Error Budget Calculator
added.description: Browser-based SLO error budget and burn-rate calculator that generates multiwindow, multi-burn-rate Prometheus alerting rules.

added.name: Cognipeer Observability
added.description: Python and TypeScript packages that send traces, tool calls, token usage, cost and latency from agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph and OpenAI Agents, and from OpenTelemetry-instrumented agents, to Cognipeer Console.

added.name: AI observability pack
added.description: Grafana dashboards, Prometheus alerts and Zabbix templates for self-hosted AI inference: vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, TEI, Triton, NVIDIA DCGM, Volcano, KServe, Ray Serve, LiteLLM, Qdrant and Weaviate.

added.name: Oxynote
added.description: Self-hosted documentation workspace where pages embed live Prometheus charts next to the text explaining them, with draft review for runbooks.

added.name: ros2_pulse
added.description: LDPRELOAD library that counts per-topic publish and callback rates inside ROS 2 processes, with a Prometheus and OTLP exporter, alert rules and a Grafana dashboard.

added.name: Caprock
added.description: Local dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Gemini CLI sessions. Shows live activity, token cost per repository and per model at API list prices, the 5-hour and weekly plan-limit windows, and alerts when a session repeats the same tool call; everything the agent wrote is searchable across sessions. Single Go binary with SQLite, loopback only, no telemetry, Apache-2.0.

added.name: zeroreads
added.description: Finds the Loki log lines no logged query, alert or dashboard reads, proves it for each rule, and writes OpenTelemetry Collector, Vector or Fluent Bit configuration that aggregates, samples, archives or drops them, with a shadow mode that measures before anything is removed.

added.name: spantruth
added.description: Checks whether LLM instrumentation reports the truth. A local fake provider serves OpenAI and Anthropic responses, including streams, prompt-cache hits, 429s and dropped connections, to OpenLLMetry, OpenInference and the OpenTelemetry GenAI instrumentation, and spantruth compares the token counts, models and errors on their spans, and whether each span ends, with what was sent. Apache-2.0.

added.name: amlint
added.description: Linter and routing simulator for Prometheus Alertmanager configurations. Finds routes that never match, inhibit rules that mute too much and notification templates that fail at send time, and runs routing unit tests in CI.

added.name: k8s-namespace-sync
added.description: Kubernetes operator that copies Secrets and ConfigMaps from a source namespace to other namespaces and keeps them in sync, including namespaces created later, with glob filters on resource names.

added.name: speedrunner
added.description: Cuts the start-up time of ansible, ansible-doc and other Ansible commands by serving them from a preloaded daemon, which helps scripts that call them many times.
